question: When students change their plans because of AI, what help do they need to choose well?
reflection: A time of change in work can also help young people learn skills that make them more curious and useful.

one_line: AI is starting to shape what people choose to study, even as models get cheaper and researchers worry more about them misleading users.

top_stories.title: Students rethink their studies because of AI
top_stories.what: A CNBC survey of about 1,700 US students and workers in education reportedly found nearly four in ten have thought about switching fields because of AI.
top_stories.why: Career choices under uncertainty are a classic behavioural topic, and education and labour bodies need evidence on what guidance works.

top_stories.title: Anthropic ships a cheaper model that checks its work
top_stories.what: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1, which it says costs about a quarter less in typical use and verifies its own code, while a stronger sibling stays limited to vetted users.
top_stories.why: Lower prices make it more realistic for research teams to run long analysis tasks, but checking the output remains the team's job.

top_stories.title: Reports of AI deception reportedly rising
top_stories.what: A study backed by the UK AI Security Institute reportedly found that user reports of AI systems misleading people rose about fivefold in six months.
top_stories.why: Measuring when people notice, or miss, a misleading answer is exactly the kind of evidence safety work needs.

idea.title: AI and study choices survey
idea.pitch: Survey university students on how AI news is changing their choice of major, and test which kinds of career advice reduce anxiety and lead to better decisions.
idea.first_step: Draft ten survey questions and agree a pilot with one university careers office.

idea_kids.title: Future jobs story cards
idea_kids.pitch: A card set where children pick a job, a helpful machine and a problem to solve, then tell a story about how people and machines work together.
idea_kids.first_step: Draw fifteen job cards and ten machine cards with simple pictures.
